name: AS:RA Ashen Skies: Radiant Arena
detailed_description:
AS:RA Ashen Skies: Radiant Arena is a competitive, team-based MOBA where powerful heroes from across time clash in a world approaching its final reckoning. Built from the ground up for cross-platform play, it brings together responsive action, layered strategy, and a focus on clarity and impact in every moment.

Every hero in ASRA is more than just a moveset—they’re part of a larger mythic cycle. Their abilities, personalities, and roles are inspired by timeless stories, reimagined to fit a world where the past and future collide. Whether you're diving into the frontline or setting the pace from afar, the game encourages bold decisions and creative play.

We’ve taken inspiration from the games we love and the stories that shaped us, and tried to build a battlefield where you can feel the weight of every move. Radiant Arena is designed to be fast, responsive, and clear in its visuals and mechanics—so you always know what’s happening and how to respond, even in the thick of a fight.

Key Features

  • 5v5 Strategic Team Battles – Classic MOBA structure with modern responsiveness and tight, impactful gameplay.

  • Distinct Heroes – A growing roster of myth-infused characters with unique abilities and meaningful roles.

  • Cross-Platform Play – Built for PC, Steam Deck, consoles, and beyond.

  • Mythic Worldbuilding – Set in an age of unraveling, where echoes of forgotten power shape every match.

  • Competitive & Casual Modes – Climb the ranks or just play with friends—your pace, your style.

This is a project we care deeply about. Ashen Skies is something we’ve built out of love for the genre and the stories that live in our heads—and we’re excited to finally share it with players who feel the same.

short_description: A multiplayer online battle arena where myth-infused heroes from across time fight for control in tactical 5v5 combat. Built for cross-platform play with fast action, deep strategy, and expressive hero design.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 5300U or Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Vega 8 / NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super or AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or newer / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 5300U or Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Vega 8 or NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti (with the latest Linux drivers)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan support required
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or newer / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or Intel Core i7-10700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6600 or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan support required; optimized for Steam Deck and Linux-compatible systems
